# Cowlendar vs Sesami in 2026: Choosing a Shopify Booking Workflow

Compare Cowlendar and Sesami by resource model, retail customization, group bookings and the plan your Shopify business actually needs.

- Canonical: https://cowlendar.com/blog/cowlendar-vs-sesami-which-shopify-booking-app-is-better-in-2026
- Published: 2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z
- Updated: 2026-09-22T16:38:32.222451Z
- Publisher: Cowlendar

## The short answer

Consider Sesami for a tailored retail booking experience and developer tooling. Consider Cowlendar for mixed booking types with a common feature set; compare the revenue tier you will need.

## Begin with the business you are building
The useful difference is not which app has the longest list. It is how your service operation should work. A retailer creating a custom consultation journey with an agency may value a different architecture from a merchant adding bookable activities to an existing store.

This guide explains the buying decision. Our [permanent Cowlendar vs Sesami comparison](/cowlendar-vs-sesami) contains the full feature table, current checked plans and source links. We publish Cowlendar, so treat our recommendation as a vendor's editorial perspective, not an independent test result.

## Understand the two pricing models
Cowlendar provides all features on the free plan, followed by booking-revenue tiers: $13.99 up to $1,000, $29.99 up to $3,000 and $59.99 up to $10,000.

Sesami's listing organizes paid plans by resources and capabilities. Small is $19 with five resources, Pro is $129 with twenty, and Premium is $299 with forty. The free option is for development stores. These monthly USD figures were checked September 22, 2026.

| Your requirement | What to examine |
| --- | --- |
| One-to-one retail appointments | Staff/resource assignment, POS workflow and customer changes |
| Group activities | Capacity behavior and the plan including groups |
| Several locations | Resource model, routing and the required tier |
| Custom storefront experience | Available APIs/SDK, implementation effort and maintenance |
| Rentals alongside appointments | Explicit date-range and shared inventory behavior |

## When Sesami deserves a close look
Sesami documents an API/SDK and POS support, which can matter when booking is part of a larger retail experience. Its higher tiers list groups, customer rescheduling, flows and multi-location capabilities.

If your agency plans a tailored interface, ask for a technical design before comparing subscriptions. Include development time, responsibility for theme updates and how errors are monitored. The ability to customize is valuable when there is a real requirement and a team to maintain it.

## When Cowlendar may be the simpler fit
Cowlendar explicitly lists one-to-one, group, multi-day, bundle and full-day bookings. A merchant combining several of those offers can evaluate them without first mapping each feature to a separate paid tier.

Usage allowances still apply to the free plan. Model the relevant revenue tier and ask support about any usage charges or requirements beyond the public plan description.

## Run a focused evaluation
Create the same service in both apps. Use the same duration, staff member, buffer, payment rule and customer information. Then attempt a conflicting reservation and a reschedule.

For a retail business, include the in-store staff workflow. For a group activity, test multiple attendees and a partial change. For a custom implementation, demonstrate both a successful booking and a failed request; customers need a usable recovery path.

## Plan a switch without losing appointments
Keep an inventory of future reservations and outstanding balances. Confirm the supported import method with the destination vendor. Run the new booking flow on an unpublished theme where possible, then reconcile availability before enabling it for customers.

Do not delete the old system until your team can account for future bookings, confirmations and payment obligations. The right choice is the system that fits your operation after launch, not only the more attractive demo.

## Common questions

### Does Sesami have a free plan for live stores?

The checked free plan is for development stores. Live merchants should compare the paid tier that covers their resources and features.

### Does Cowlendar replace every custom Sesami implementation?

No. Evaluate APIs, resource rules and any custom storefront behavior individually. A standard booking widget and a bespoke implementation are different projects.
